name: Family Ventures public thesis - Venture pre-screening
source_note: Built from Family Ventures' public website. It is an illustrative pre-screening framework, not an official or complete investment mandate.
scope: Venture opportunities only. Secondary and buyout opportunities are outside this MVP.

criteria.label: B2B or enterprise relevance
criteria.description: The company sells to businesses, enterprises, industrial customers or institutions.

criteria.label: International or global-first ambition
criteria.description: The company operates internationally or has a credible plan to expand beyond one domestic market.

criteria.label: Relevant technology or transition theme
criteria.description: The company operates in Enterprise AI, Physical AI, energy, climate, longevity, fintech, digital or a closely related area.

criteria.label: Industrial transformation or European competitiveness
criteria.description: The company can transform an industry, strengthen essential infrastructure or improve European competitiveness.

criteria.label: Potential value from the Family Ventures network
criteria.description: The company may benefit from industrial expertise, commercial introductions, partnerships or go-to-market support.
